description: West Virginia Structural Health Monitoring Project [supporting dataset] is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Andrew Foden, Michael Lodes. Data Management Plan Note: This project has an accompanying Data Management Plan (DMP). This plan has been included as a PDF in this data package, but is also available publicly in the DMPTool Here: https://doi.org/10.48321/D1FW9C National Transportation Library (NTL) Curation Note: This dataset has been curated to CoreTrustSeal's curation level "A. Active Preservation". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-PDDC. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
